description: Cs₃Na₂SnP₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmce space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five P atoms. There are a spread of Cs-P bond distances ranging from 3.67-3.91 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five P atoms. There are a spread of Cs-P bond distances ranging from 3.57-4.01 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are two shorter (2.93 Å) and two longer (2.99 Å) Na-P bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent P atoms to form distorted NaP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SnP₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one SnP₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaP₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.93 Å) and two longer (3.07 Å) Na-P bond lengths. Sn is bonded to four P atoms to form distorted SnP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaP₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaP₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SnP₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.58 Å) and two longer (2.65 Å) Sn-P bond lengths. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to five Cs, three Na, and one Sn atom. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to five Cs, two equivalent Na, and two equivalent Sn atoms.
